text: {"assertions":["A plan drift issue was identified in infra/terraform/vpc.tf that only affected users in negative UTC offsets.","The root cause of the VPC plan drift was a missing composite index on the (tenant_id, created_at) columns.","The plan drift was manifesting as unexpected diffs on resources that had not been edited.","The fix was implemented by adding the composite index and performing batch backfill operations in PR #1221 on the fix/plan-drift-1 branch.","The plan drift could be reproduced by running terraform plan twice consecutively with no changes between runs.","The backlog cleared 40 minutes after the fix was deployed.","This work continued context from earlier plan drift work in the same file."]}
